ui.title: TotK Setup
ui.rebuild_title: Rebuilding the game for your mods
ui.intro: Builds a playable Tears of the Kingdom folder from your own game files. This takes a while and runs once.
ui.notice: The folder this setup builds contains the game. It is for your own use only; do not share or upload it.
ui.keys_private: The keys file is read in place. Its contents are never shown, copied or stored.
ui.base: Base game (NSP, XCI, NSZ or XCZ)
ui.pick_update: Choose the 1.1.0 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update file
ui.firmware_help: For Chinese, Korean and Traditional Chinese text: the firmware's Contents/registered folder, for example from Ryujinx or Yuzu. The setup copies the Switch system fonts from it into the install folder.
ui.dlss: Download NVIDIA DLSS (nvngx_dlss.dll) for NVIDIA RTX graphics cards
ui.dlss_help: From NVIDIA's DLSS SDK on GitHub, under NVIDIA's RTX SDK license (github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS). It makes the dlaa and DLSS settings work; without it they do nothing.
ui.fsr: Download AMD FSR 4 (amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll) for AMD Radeon graphics cards
ui.fsr_help: From AMD's FSR SDK on GitHub, under AMD's FSR SDK license (github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK). It lets the dlaa setting run FSR (Upscaler: AMD FSR in the menu); without it that choice does nothing.
ui.compressed_help: Compressed NSZ and XCZ files work as they are: the setup unpacks them by itself (until the game data is extracted, that needs as much free space as the unpacked files take).
ui.update_mode: This folder holds an earlier installation. The setup continues or updates it; the game files are asked for only if they are needed again.
ui.need_update: Choose the 1.1.0 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update file.
ui.missing_base: The base game file does not exist.
ui.missing_update: The update file does not exist.
ui.missing_keys: The keys file does not exist.
ui.missing_firmware: The firmware folder does not exist.
ui.done_text: Start {game_exe} from {dest}. The setup program and the game files you chose are no longer needed.
ui.cancelled_text: The finished steps are kept. Start the setup again with the same folder to continue.
ui.confirm_cancel: The setup is running. Cancel it and close the window?

ui.space_two: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB); on {temp}: {temp_need} GB (free: {temp_free} GB).
